name: Towa
source:
A noble existence who is considered to be the cornerstone of Migiwa. He is worshiped as a god. Located in the capital city, he maintains a barrier to protect the city. He is the eldest son of the king and the older brother of [url=/c88847]Takeru[/url]. He never leaves the castle, except for the New Year's celebration. He is never seen by the public.
His tsukai is a white eagle named Yokaze.
